@dmsd_pool_size = 50

dmsd_init_pool = {
	clear_global_variable_list = dmsd_free_pool
	set_global_variable = { name = dmsd_pool_idx value = 0 }
	every_location_in_the_world = {
		limit = { global_var:dmsd_pool_idx < @dmsd_pool_size }
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = dmsd_free_pool target = this }
		change_global_variable = { name = dmsd_pool_idx add = 1 }
	}
	remove_global_variable = dmsd_pool_idx
}
